msvc.note: PLAN ASSUMPTION REFUTED - VS2022 was NOT required. whisper.cpp and ggml compiled cleanly with v142. Risk R2 retired.

critical_finding.title: whisper.cpp was compiling unoptimized (no /O2) despite CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
critical_finding.cause: The cmake crate overwrites CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE with cc-derived flags that contain no optimization switch, so MSVC falls back to /Od.
critical_finding.fix: Set CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE and CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE as env vars; whisper-rs-sys/build.rs forwards any CMAKE_* env var into the cmake config. Pinned in .cargo/config.toml.
critical_finding.rejected_fix: CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS env vars - the cmake crate overrides them, and the attempt fails silently.
critical_finding.impact: Would have corrupted every Phase 1b number and driven model selection toward a far weaker model than this hardware can run.

measurements.conditions: jfk.wav 11.0 s, AC power, warm pass (pass 1 of 2), Balanced power plan
measurements.thread_cliff_note: 14 threads measured 23x slower than 10. Never default to all logical processors.
measurements.variance_warning: tiny.en@10 measured 620 ms and 1255 ms across separate runs. Single samples are meaningless; Phase 1b must record p50/p95 over repeated runs.
